Then a change that removes, renames or retypes a property is declared as a new major version

  Scenario: AC8 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the state of a rollback is the single value ROLLED_BACK of AC2
    When a status change to a value other than ROLLED_BACK is requested for a rollback
    Then the change is refused with one of the failures declared in AC3
    Then nothing is written
